releases.body: Memory your agents actually get: every prompt now asks Estelle for up to 5 relevant memories (dated, with their source) and injects them; a <private>...</private> span keeps text out of capture and recall; wider secret redaction; repo identity from any remote. Subagents are supervised: a stalled or failing subagent is reported to the main agent with its next moves, a Stop with children still running says so, and subagents get the same Estelle context and their own identity. A stale install now says it is behind and how to update. Kimi Code 2.6 turns are captured again.

Subagents show in Estelle the moment they start and end on their own stop, in every host that has subagents: Claude Code and Codex mirror each subagent's steps under its parent; Cursor, Grok, Qwen and Kimi post each subagent's start, result and end. Fixes a test fixture that aged out on its own (the clock is now passed in).
Estelle now installs in Qwen Code, Hermes Agent, mini-swe-agent, OpenClaw and fx. Each host's setup guide is in docs/install/ and at estelle.fatelabs.ca/docs.
Codex and OpenCode subagents are captured and shown under their parent session. Questions about your uploaded docs route to estelle_intake.
Subagent timelines are captured again (Claude Code): each subagent's steps show under its parent session and in the left rail. Includes 0.0.20 (intent map for every host).
